capabilities.contract: Do not mount a second Vite application or BrowserRouter inside Databench.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Databench owns boot, route registration and the top-level error boundary.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Databench shell behavior is authoritative.

capabilities.contract: EvalScope logo, GitHub entry and duplicate theme/locale controls are not presented as Databench assets.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Use the existing Databench navigation, theme and react-i18next locale.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Existing Databench shell keyboard and narrow-screen behavior remains authoritative.

capabilities.contract: Keep visible Refresh/Rescan while removing editable absolute report-root input.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Refresh cancels stale requests, advances generation and resets cache, filters, page and selection.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Named button remains visible and keyboard operable on dashboard, reports and performance pages.

capabilities.contract: Preserve every user-visible open-in-new-tab action without exposing raw active HTML.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Open /evaluations/viewer?document=<opaque-id> with noopener and noreferrer.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Use a named link; popup-blocked state is visible and announced.

capabilities.contract: Pinned Zod request and response adapters cover every UI-used EvalScope endpoint and typed error.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Unknown response shapes fail closed before reaching a page domain model.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Schema failures render the page's accessible error state.

capabilities.contract: Preserve the business controls' upstream keyboard, focus, screen-reader and narrow-layout behavior while restyling them with Databench primitives.
capabilities.default_or_rule: A visual primitive replacement cannot remove labels, touch targets, focus visibility, state semantics or responsive presentation.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: This capability is the shared responsive and accessibility contract for all migrated routes.

capabilities.contract: Render every metric using its native scale, precision, direction and boundedness.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Do not assume scores are 0..1; unbounded or heterogeneous metrics cannot produce a misleading radar.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Text and table fallback carries the same formatted value and direction as charts.

capabilities.contract: Polling, URL query state, copy actions and form errors preserve upstream cancellation and cleanup behavior.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Unmount, route change and refresh abort obsolete work; degraded polling keeps the last valid state.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Copy and field errors expose named controls and announced status.

capabilities.contract: Every upstream business label, state and Benchmark Markdown language choice has a Databench locale mapping.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Use current Databench locale; missing keys fail parity drift tests.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Localized accessible names remain present in Chinese and English.

capabilities.contract: Show evaluation count, performance count, distinct model count and latest-run time; preserve clickable KPI navigation.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Counts combine configured-root evaluation and performance reports.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: KPI links remain named and keyboard operable in the narrow layout.

capabilities.contract: Merge evaluation and performance runs, sort by time without pre-truncation, then filter, search, paginate and navigate rows.
capabilities.default_or_rule: All type is default; search spans model, dataset, provider and protocol.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Desktop rows and narrow cards expose equivalent links, labels and pagination.

capabilities.contract: Render loading, welcome, no-data, no-match and partial-data states without hiding the successful source.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Evaluation or performance failure does not discard the other source's feed.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Status headings and recovery actions are announced and keyboard operable.

capabilities.contract: Expose Evaluation and Performance tabs with typed URL state and direct-refresh restoration.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Evaluation is the default when tab is absent or invalid.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Tabs implement labelled keyboard navigation on desktop and narrow screens.

capabilities.contract: Preserve model, endpoint, key, datasets, limit, repeats, work directory, generation, judge and advanced fields with payload parity.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Upstream defaults and first-invalid focus are preserved; secrets never enter URLs or persisted browser state.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Every control has a label, field error and deterministic focus order.

capabilities.contract: Suggest Benchmark names from the pinned text and multimodal lists while allowing valid manual names.
capabilities.default_or_rule: At most eight suggestions; multi-value input; agent and AIGC suggestion expansion is not upstream parity.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter and Escape work; outside click closes the named listbox.

capabilities.contract: Keep arbitrary JSON-object editing and raw-input preservation while recursively rejecting path, directory, URL and URI locators.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Reject normalized locator keys plus POSIX, drive, UNC, traversal, file: and URI-like values with dataset_args_locator_forbidden.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Field-level error preserves and refocuses the original editor contents.

capabilities.contract: Preserve the complete Performance form, defaults, conditional fields, payload and validation.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Model endpoint defaults remain upstream-equivalent subject to the operator endpoint policy.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Every conditional field is labelled and first-invalid focus is deterministic.

capabilities.contract: Invoke, poll progress, page logs, stop, show terminal result and navigate to reports for evaluation and performance tasks.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Disconnect preserves the last state; duplicate submit is blocked; stop and failure races have one visible terminal outcome.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Progress, log updates, stop state and errors are announced without moving focus unexpectedly.

capabilities.contract: Preserve 300ms search, model and dataset multi-select, score range, four sort keys, direction, chips and per-item/clear actions.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Page size is 20 and every filter mutation returns to page one.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Filters and chips remain labelled and keyboard removable in table and card layouts.

capabilities.contract: Use desktop table and narrow cards as equivalent responsive presentations; do not add a non-upstream view toggle.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Row/card detail navigation and displayed model, dataset, score and time remain equivalent.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Both presentations expose the same accessible names and actions.

capabilities.contract: Preserve current-page select-all, cross-filter/sort selection, cap five, clear and contextual HTML/Compare actions.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Exactly one selection enables View HTML; at least two enable Compare; compare consumes the first three.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Selection count, cap notice and disabled-action reason are announced.

capabilities.contract: Preserve loading, retry, no-data, no-match, clear-filters, create-task and browse-benchmark actions.
capabilities.default_or_rule: A refresh error does not silently replace previously visible valid data.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Recovery action and error summary are named and focusable.

capabilities.contract: Preserve report identity, average, best, worst, total summary and Overview/Details/Predictions tabs.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Overview is default; dataset and subset navigation update the relevant tab and selection.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Header actions and tabs remain named and keyboard operable.

capabilities.contract: Preserve sortable dataset score/sample table, dataset navigation, conditional table/radar switch and collapsible Task Config JSON.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Radar requires at least three comparable bounded datasets; heterogeneous or unbounded metrics use table only.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Chart has an equivalent table and Task Config exposes unknown fields via JSON fallback.

capabilities.contract: Preserve overall score, analysis Markdown, sortable subset/metric/score/count table and performance metrics panel.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Clicking a subset switches to Predictions with that subset selected.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Sortable headers and subset links expose state and destination.

capabilities.contract: Preserve subset selector, score threshold and All/Above/Below views with counts.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Threshold is a view filter only and never rewrites metric pass/fail semantics.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Threshold label, selected state and counts are announced.

capabilities.contract: Preserve previous/next, sample X/Y, original Index display and direct sample-index jump.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Invalid or filtered-out index keeps the current sample and renders a field error.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Previous/next and jump controls have labels and keyboard focus.

capabilities.contract: Search by message-ID prefix, navigate to the matching sample/message and visibly highlight it.
capabilities.default_or_rule: No or ambiguous match produces an accessible error without losing current selection.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Enter activates search and the highlighted message is programmatically identifiable.

capabilities.contract: Preserve legacy Input/Generated fallback, structured Messages and traced timeline plus expected/extracted and normalized/raw scoring.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Generated and Pred remain distinct; Score JSON, Metadata and unknown fields use collapsible JSON fallback.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Reading order follows conversation order and collapsibles expose state.

capabilities.contract: Render system, user, assistant, reasoning and tool messages with copy, token/perf chips, tool arguments, result, error and latency.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Reasoning is collapsible; tool errors do not hide other messages.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Roles, tool names, collapsed state and copy result have accessible labels/status.

capabilities.contract: Render steps, cross-step tool-result links, environment execution, nudges, loop errors, stop reason and residual tool messages.
capabilities.default_or_rule: A missing linked step degrades locally to JSON/text without dropping the trace.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Step order, link destination and terminal reason are available without relying on color.

capabilities.contract: Render Markdown, GFM, KaTeX, highlighted code/copy, image lightbox, audio, video and JSON fallback with bounded virtualization.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Long predictions/messages/traces virtualize; failed media and unknown content remain local visible fallbacks.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Media alternatives, lightbox close, code copy and virtual rows remain keyboard/screen-reader usable.

capabilities.contract: Restore two to three model slots from URL and support report-name add, remove and cancel-add actions.
capabilities.default_or_rule: At least two and at most three slots; invalid URL entries produce an incompatibility state, not extra slots.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Slot labels, remove buttons and add dialog are keyboard operable.

capabilities.contract: Preserve Score and Prediction tabs, average row, dataset rows, radar and chart fallback.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Score is default; non-comparable metrics use the fallback table.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Chart values have table equivalents and tabs expose selection state.

capabilities.contract: Compute the common dataset and subset intersection for selected runs.
capabilities.default_or_rule: No intersection renders a reason and preserves slot selection.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Incompatibility reason is announced and does not trap focus.

capabilities.contract: Preserve threshold, per-model Any/Above/Below, All Any/All Above/All Below presets and each model's above rate.
capabilities.default_or_rule: All Any is default and filters apply to aligned samples only.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Per-model grouping and preset state are programmatically labelled.

capabilities.contract: Preserve aligned-sample pagination, previous/next, Left/Right navigation and showing X of Y.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Keyboard navigation is ignored while editing a field and cannot move beyond bounds.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Current position and disabled boundary controls are announced.

capabilities.contract: Render one ChatView per model with score and delta; one malformed column cannot hide valid columns.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Column-local errors preserve aligned sample position and the other model results.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Columns have model headings and a deterministic reading order on narrow screens.

capabilities.contract: Search model, dataset, API type, provider and protocol; sort by time, RPS and latency; display provider and protocol separately.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Time sort is the upstream default and search spans normalized metadata fallbacks.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Rows/cards and sort state expose equivalent labels.

capabilities.contract: Preserve selection cap notice and clear; one has_html run enables View HTML, two or more enable Compare, first three are compared.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Actions remain disabled with a visible reason when their cardinality or HTML condition is unmet.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Selection count and action eligibility are announced.

capabilities.contract: Preserve refresh, retry, no-data and no-match; schema-invalid refresh keeps existing valid rows visible.
capabilities.default_or_rule: A refresh error marks stale data and never silently clears it.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Refresh status and retry action are announced.

capabilities.contract: Resolve provider from metadata, then known host, then Custom; display Provider and Protocol separately.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Explicit metadata wins and unknown hosts never masquerade as a known provider.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Metadata labels remain distinct in summary and narrow layouts.

capabilities.contract: Preserve Overview, Charts and Runs; single-run reports hide Charts, default to Runs and use run-specific summary/config copy.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Multi-run defaults to Overview; direct invalid chart tab on single-run normalizes to Runs.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Hidden tabs are absent from keyboard order and selected tab is announced.

capabilities.contract: Preserve KPI, summary table, best/run config, recommendations and chart groups.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Unlimited request rate displays closed-loop rather than INF.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: KPI and chart data have textual/table equivalents.

capabilities.contract: Embedding and rerank reports hide TTFT, TPOT and token percentiles and omit inapplicable charts.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Inapplicable metrics are absent, not zero-valued placeholders.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Remaining metrics retain coherent headings and table associations.

capabilities.contract: Preserve per-run selector, concurrency/request-count/rate workload, percentile table and charts.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Workload normalization distinguishes closed-loop and rate-driven runs.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Run selector and percentile table remain labelled and keyboard operable.

capabilities.contract: Preserve All/Success/Failed filters, total count, 50 rows per page, pagination, charts and request table.
capabilities.default_or_rule: All is default; no database and no percentile data are distinct states.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Filter state, page position and request status are not conveyed by color alone.

capabilities.contract: Default to oldest baseline and newest candidate; swap baseline/candidate and persist the choice in URL.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Direct refresh restores the same baseline and candidate.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Baseline/candidate labels and swap action are explicit and keyboard operable.

capabilities.contract: Show baseline/candidate/sample counts, absolute delta, percent delta and direction-aware improvement/regression/neutral/incomputable verdict.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Metric direction determines verdict; zero or missing denominator produces incomputable, not infinity.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Verdict includes text and signs, never color alone.

capabilities.contract: Preserve critical, warning and normal sample-confidence states and percentile de-emphasis.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Less than 30 is critical, 30 through 99 warning, and 100 or more normal.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Warning severity and affected percentile content are announced.

capabilities.contract: Preserve workload mismatch, missing perf data, sparse comparison and symmetric config diff.
capabilities.default_or_rule: An incomputable metric degrades locally while other metrics and charts remain visible.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Mismatch and config differences are textual, grouped and navigable.

capabilities.contract: Preserve embedding/rerank chart conditions, latency and throughput chart groups and fallback table.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Unavailable chart data uses the table without hiding valid chart groups.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Every chart group has a heading and table equivalent.

capabilities.contract: Preserve All, Text, Multimodal, Agent and AIGC tabs with category counts.
capabilities.default_or_rule: All is default and category changes reset pagination to page one.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Scrollable narrow tab list retains aria-pressed state and keyboard access.

capabilities.contract: Preserve 300ms search, tag multi-filter, active search/tag chips, per-item removal and clear.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Search spans name, pretty name, localized description and tags; any selected tag may match.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Filter toolbar, selected tags and clear actions are named and keyboard operable.

capabilities.contract: Preserve 24 cards per page, responsive one/two/three-column grid, badge, samples, subsets, few-shot, tags and metrics.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Every tab, search and tag mutation resets page one; page clamps after result shrink.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Cards expose name and metadata and remain activatable without pointer input.

capabilities.contract: Preserve detail modal, complete Chinese/English Markdown, metadata and external Paper link.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Description follows Databench locale; missing language uses the upstream no-description state.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Modal traps/restores focus, Escape/backdrop closes, Paper link identifies external navigation.

capabilities.contract: Preserve loading and no-result states for the catalogue.
capabilities.default_or_rule: No-result state reflects active search, category and tag filters.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Loading and empty status are announced without focus loss.

capabilities.contract: Preserve report/chart loading, error and display while preventing raw active HTML from entering the DOM or top-level window.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Use opaque document ID, sanitizer, local Plotly and a sandbox without allow-same-origin; reject top-level generated-document fetch.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Viewer has a title, loading/error status and safe same-page/new-tab navigation.

capabilities.contract: Allow a Benchmark detail to open the Databench task page with that Benchmark preselected.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Works for all five catalogue tabs and never contributes to upstream parity coverage.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Extension action is explicitly named and has a deterministic destination.

capabilities.contract: Add Databench Dataset exact-version selection, projection eligibility/fidelity and explicit reference-target choice to the Evaluation form.
capabilities.default_or_rule: Source switching isolates payloads; selected, ground truth or no reference is always an explicit user choice.
capabilities.responsive_a11y: Ref, exact version, task type, target and fidelity status form one labelled field group.
